data.name: Shadowy Appearance
data.description: A cabalist becomes cloaked in shadow while in his vigilante identity. He gains a continuous 20%% miss chance (as per blur). The cabalist can deactivate or reactivate this effect as a standard action. Once per day, he can spend an immediate action to gain the benefits of greater invisibility for 1d6 rounds.
